summary: Signal Analytics Backtester and Improvements testing complete. All 25 tests passed. Fixed 2 bugs: 1) ValueError when parsing '0.65+' confidence bucket, 2) Internal function calls failing due to FastAPI Query parameters. New endpoints working: POST /track-prices, POST /backtest, GET /backtest/optimal, POST /apply-improvements. Strategy engine MIN_SIGNAL_CONFIDENCE confirmed at 0.55.

bugs_fixed.issue: ValueError: could not convert string to float: '0.65+' when parsing confidence bucket
bugs_fixed.fix: Added handling for bucket formats like '0.65+' that don't have '-' separator

bugs_fixed.issue: Internal calls to run_backtest failed with 'cannot encode object: Query(None)' because FastAPI Query parameters can't be called directly
bugs_fixed.fix: Refactored to separate _run_backtest_internal() function for programmatic calls and _find_optimal_settings_internal() for apply-improvements

track_prices.description: Tracks price changes for recent signals, populates signal_outcomes collection

backtest_optimal.description: Runs multiple backtests to find optimal confidence threshold and strategy settings

apply_improvements.description: Returns recommended changes based on backtest results

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 59 verified Signal Analytics Backtester. Key endpoints: POST /api/signal-analytics/track-prices (tracks prices for signals), POST /api/signal-analytics/backtest (runs backtest with configurable params), GET /api/signal-analytics/backtest/optimal (finds optimal settings), POST /api/signal-analytics/apply-improvements (returns recommendations). Strategy engine uses MIN_SIGNAL_CONFIDENCE=0.55 and MIN_INDIVIDUAL_CONFIDENCE=0.50. Two bugs were fixed: 1) ValueError parsing '0.65+' bucket, 2) FastAPI Query params in internal function calls. Price fetching falls back to simulated prices when API unavailable.
